name: Potje Rijden: Kirgizië
overview: Sean and Stefan go head-to-head in a race through the rugged landscape of Kyrgyzstan. Together with four travel companions, Ta Joela, ACID, Frank van der Slot, and Raúl, they face the adventure and race against the clock. During the race, they can earn time by completing hilarious and challenging tasks. And the team that sets the best time wins.
